subject: The Overture
what: The City's CY2021 annual-progress-report PDF lists this 44-unit building as completed; the state's public copy of the same report (HCD's open-data file) has no row for it.
note: Re-confirmed 2026-09-29 against the CY2021 PDF (both this row and The Den).

subject: The Den
what: The City's CY2021 PDF logs a completion here (36 units); the state's public copy drops the row. We count 40 from the building's own records.

subject: Poet's Place
what: The City reported the building permit (41 units, 2022) but no completion, although the building was finaled on 2025-03-20. Its rooms are single-room-occupancy tenancies, which HCD counts as housing units.
evidence: HCD APR table A2 (CY2022 BP row; no CO row); https://pub-2cee87f70da64080ab70ee0a34b55099.r2.dev/architect_plans/proj932_san-pablo-ave_2021-11-18_drc-staff-report-2435.pdf

subject: Step Up Housing
what: The City reported the building permit (39 units, 2023) but no completion, although the building opened in 2025. Rooms are SRO tenancies: tenants pay 30% of income (City memo, 2023-08-22).
evidence: HCD APR table A2 (CY2023 BP row; no CO row); https://berkeleyca.gov/sites/default/files/documents/2023-08-22%20Update%20on%20Step-Up%20Housing%20-%20Off%20Agenda%20Memo.pdf; https://pub-2cee87f70da64080ab70ee0a34b55099.r2.dev/architect_plans/proj158_1367-university-ave_2020-06-30.pdf

subject: 2100 San Pablo (Spirit Living)
what: The City counted 96 units at completion. The building is a licensed residential care facility for the elderly: shared rooms, no kitchens, central dining. The City's own zoning staff report found it is NOT a housing development project under state law. HCD treats such assisted-living facilities as group quarters, not housing units.
note: The City's own records also say 94 suites while every count says 96, and report the entitlement twice (2018 and 2022).

subject: 2000 Dwight
what: The City counted 113 units. The plans show 88 apartments with their own kitchens and 25 memory-care rooms without kitchens; the City's planner wrote it was 'continuing to count all units, including the 2nd floor units without kitchens'. HCD counts the 88; the memory-care rooms are group quarters.

subject: 2100 San Pablo entitlement reported twice
what: The same 96-unit entitlement appears in the CY2018 and CY2022 reports.
evidence: HCD APR table A2 rows 2018 and 2022

subject: Step Up report rows

subject: Logan Park South counted twice
what: Our 2026-09-26 rebuild counted the building's Phase I and Phase II permits (69 units each). Fixed 2026-09-29: the Phase II permit carries the units.

subject: A re-final counted twice
what: A house with an attached ADU was finaled in 2021 and again in 2026; both were counted. Fixed 2026-09-29 (count once, at the first final).

subject: Care and congregate buildings judged by their label
what: Our model read three such buildings from the permit's label; the unit plans overturned or reframed each (2000 Dwight, 2100 San Pablo, Step Up). Such permits now read as 'unclear' until someone reads the plans.

subject: A false fact taken from the City report
what: Our ledger once credited Step Up's rooms with in-room kitchens, citing the City's report note. The plans show none. The City report is our comparison target, never a source; the evidence was replaced.

subject: Retractions from July
what: We retracted in writing: a mis-adjudication of the Overture (the state copy was the problem, not the City), an early 'the City mis-filed El Jardin' hypothesis (the City was right: 55 co-living apartments), and a phased-building demotion premised on an expired permit.

subject: An unworked inspection queue
what: Our classifier parked 'alteration with conversion language' for inspection, and that queue went unworked: about 190 units of garage conversions, basement ADUs and legalizations the City correctly credited and we initially did not.

subject: An electrical permit read as 5 new units
what: Permit B2024-05916 says only 'Renew old permit B2017-02937'. That 2017 permit is an electrical permit: 'upgrade main service to 200 amps, with (6) meter change outs, & (6) 60 amp sub-panels'. Our model read the permit's unit field (5, the building's existing units) as 5 new units. The City correctly counts none. Corrected 2026-09-30 by a reading ruling (in live v4 since the 2026-09-30 swap): our count fell by 5, and building permits by 5. Accela itself lists B2024-05916 as an 'Electrical Permit'. Its full record at 1421 Arch, 2010-2026, is three items: a 2010 foundation and retaining-wall clearance, the 2017 electrical upgrade, and its 2024 renewal; nothing creates units. No record under a '0 Arch' address; the assessor shows improvements of $36,762 and a non-residential use code.

subject: A rear-structure remodel read as 4 new units
what: B2017-05275 completes work under B2014-04083, whose Accela record reads 'REMOVE DELAPIDATED REAR 2 STORY STRUCTURE AND EXIT STAIRS AND REPLACE WITH NEW 363 SQ.FT. STRUCTURE' (valuation $43,121, Closed Expired). Its revisions convert storage to laundry and bring the 2nd floor to code. The parcel is the landmark Woolley and Blood houses (relocated under 2007-2013 Planning approvals; Mills Act 2014) over a ground-floor cafe. Nothing creates units; the model read the unit field (4, the existing apartments) as new units. The City correctly counts none.
evidence: data/raw/accela/capdetail_manual/B2014-04083_2026-09-30.txt (Accela CapDetail 2026-09-30); data/raw/accela/date_range/Building_*.jsonl and Planning_*.jsonl records at 2501 Telegraph
ledger_ref: reading ruling APPROVED 2026-09-30: B2017-05275 new_unit/4 -> alteration/0 (applies at the next chain rebuild)
note: Found while attributing the +61. Same failure as 1421 Arch (O07).

subject: An existing duplex's electrical upgrade read as 2 new units
what: B2024-03341: 'duplex at 2212 McGee and 2214 McGee. upgrade service to 200amp. replace two existing 70amp panels'. The building is an existing duplex (assessor use code 2600); a 2023 housing-code case (H2023-00659) already required water heaters 'for unit 2212 and 2214'. Nothing new was built; the model read the duplex's 2 units as new. The City correctly counts none.

subject: An electrical permit read as 3 new units (a double count of an ADU)
what: B2019-02963 is an Electrical Permit (Accela): 'Replace single unit with main to (2) unit main adding legal cottage'; Closed Expired, never finaled. The cottage itself was built under B2018-00483 ('Remodel (E) workshop to in law unit'), which we count once (1 unit, finaled 2019). The model credited the electrical permit with 3 new units at issuance. Completions are unaffected; building permits are 3 too high (2019, 5th cycle).

subject: A house remodel read as a new unit (a double count of an ADU)
what: B2018-01255 remodels the existing house: 'raising (E) structure 5.5', adding 515.7 SF of finished habitable space to lower level' (valuation $320,000; UnitsAdded blank, NumberUnits 1 = the house). The ADU was built under its own permit, B2018-01256 ('Demo portion of garage/storage building and build attached ADU to garage', UnitsAdded 1, finaled 2023), addressed #B in 2022, and counted once. The model counted the remodel as a second new unit: completions +1 (2020), permits +1 (2018).
